svg.text: Five identities exercise every layer: operator (all scopes), agent (read-only), burst (ops:read), guest (may invoke, NOT registered), stranger (may not invoke).

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Server service accounts hold only what their tools need; none has a key. Tool arguments are never logged: a digest and the argument names are.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No OAuth authorization server and no IAP: humans and agents authenticate with Google identity tokens. Human CLI tokens carry the shared gcloud client audience (accepted for

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: people, refused for service accounts). Note text is untrusted data: results carry a warning, but a model can still be steered by it. Rate limits are per caller, fixed-window.

svg.text: The client sends a Google-signed identity token; the service URL is the audience for service accounts

svg.text: Cloud Run IAM rejects callers without roles/run.invoker before any of our code runs (mcp-stranger)

svg.text: mcp-ops tools: list services, recent errors of a service (validated), dry-run BigQuery cost — all read-only

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: mcp-notes tools: add, search, get, delete — each note belongs to its writer; others get an identical 'not found'

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every request increments a per-caller Firestore counter (shared across instances); over the limit returns 429 + Retry-After

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every allow/deny is logged as structured JSON with caller, tool, decision, reason, latency

Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A log sink lands those lines in BigQuery for SQL over who called what and what was refused
